description.p: Peek is a QuickLook-class file previewer for the COSMIC desktop. Point it at a file and it shows you the file — the picture, the pages, the video, the source with its syntax coloured, the contents of the archive — without opening an application.
It maps a layer-shell overlay above the panel, takes the keyboard while it is open, and gets out of the way on the next key press. The arrow keys walk the rest of the directory.

ul.li: Images, with EXIF orientation applied and camera details shown
SVG, rendered at display size rather than scaled from a thumbnail
Source and plain text, with syntax highlighting in light and dark
Video and audio, with real playback, seeking, and a poster frame
Directories, summarised — and anything else as a metadata card

description.p: Peek serves org.gnome.NautilusPreviewer2, so the space bar previews the selection in Nautilus with no further setup.
